description: Implementation of a pseudo-random generator with functions for initialization, state advancement, bit and float generation, and XOR application, utilizing SIMD instructions for performance optimization.

classes.name: pseudo_random_generator_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for pseudo-random generator functions, managing internal state and providing generation and XOR methods.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the generator state with a seed or provided state.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances the internal state by a specified number of steps.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates pseudo-random bits into a bit buffer.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates pseudo-random floats with a specified value.

methods.name: apply_xor
methods.description: Applies XOR operation between generated pseudo-random sequence and input buffers (bit_buffer, span<uint8_t>, span<log_likelihood_ratio>).

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the current internal state of the generator.
